::: proof

Writing the dot product componentwise:

$$
\ba
\vecf{e}_j \cdot \vx
&= \sum_{i=1}^{p} (\vecf{e}_j)_i\, x_i
&& \text{(definition of the dot product)}
\\&= \sum_{i=1}^{p}
   \begin{cases}
   1 \cdot x_i & \text{if } i = j \\
   0 \cdot x_i & \text{if } i \neq j
   \end{cases}
&& \text{(definition of } \vecf{e}_j \text{)}
\\&= x_j
&& \text{(only the } i = j \text{ term is nonzero)}
\ea
$$

:::
